Parameters pcCodigos

lcQuery = [Select * From SigPrTra Where TPTrans = ']+pcCodigos+[']

ThisForm.Grid1.RecordSource = ''

With ThisForm
	.poDataMgr = CreateObject('fSqlConector', ThisForm.Name)
	
	With .poDataMgr
		* Cursor Principal Para Montagem da Lista (Tabela Grande)
		.AddCursor('SigPrTrn', 'cIdChaves', 'crSigPrTrn', '', .f.,lcQuery)
	EndWith
	
	.poDataMgr.Requery('crSigPrTrn')
	
EndWith

Select crSigPrTrn
Index On Emps+TpTrans+Tps Tag EmpTp
Set Order To EmpTp
Go Top

=fAcessoEmpresa(Usuar, 'C', This.Value, ThisForm.Grid1.Column1.Text1, '', ThisForm.poDataMgr)

If ! Empty(This.Value)
	lnReg = Recno()

	Select crSigPrTrn
	lcEmp   = Emps
	lcTra   = TpTrans
	lcTps   = Tps
	lcChave = cIdChaves
	Locate for Emps = lcEmp And TpTrans = lcTra And Tps = lcTps And cIdChaves <> lcChave
	If ! Eof()
		MessageBox('Tipo de Transferencia Cadastrada',16,'')
		Go lnReg
		This.Value = ''
		Return .f.
	Endif

	Go lnReg
Endif

		m.loBrowse.AddColuna('Codigos', '', 'Código',    .t., 'Codigos')
		m.loBrowse.AddColuna('Descrs',  '', 'Descrição', .t., 'Descrs')
		m.loBrowse.Show
	EndIf
	Set Near Off
	This.Value = Evaluate('crSigPrTrn.Codigos')
	This.Refresh
Else
	This.Value = ''
EndIf
This.Refresh

If ! Empty(This.Value)
	ln... [TRUNCADO]

If !Empty(This.Value) And Not InList(This.Value,'T','R')
	=MessageBox('Opcao Inválida. Informe <T>ransporte <R>ecepcao ', 0+48, '')
	This.Value = ''
	Return 0
EndIf
This.Refresh

	lcEmp   = Emps
	lcTra   = TpTrans
	lcTps   = Tps
	lcChave = cIdChaves
	Locate for Emps = lcEmp And TpTrans = lcTra And Tps = lcTps And cIdChaves <> lcChave
	If ! Eof()
		MessageBox('Tipo de Transferencia Cadastrada',16,'')
		Go lnReg
		This.Value = ''
		Retur... [TRUNCADO]

Select crSigPrTrn
Go Top
Scan
	If Empty(Emps) 
		MessageBox('Empresa Invalida !!',16,'')
		Thisform.Grid1.Column1.Text1.SetFocus
		Return
	Endif

*		MessageBox('Tipo de Transporte Invalido !!',16,'')
*		Thisform.Grid1.Column2.Text1.SetFocus
*		Return
*	Endif
	If Empty(Tps) 
		MessageBox('Tipo Invalido !!',16,'')
		Thisform.Grid1.Column3.Text1.SetFocus
		Return
	Endif
EndScan

ThisForm.poDatamgr.Update('crSigPrTrn')
ThisForm.poDatamgr.Commit()

=fGravarLog('G', 'SigPrTrnG', 'G... [TRUNCADO]

Locate For Empty(Emps) And Empty(TpTrans) And Empty(Tps)
If Eof()

	Replace cIdChaves With fUniqueIds()
	Go Top
EndIf
ThisForm.Refresh
=fGravarLog('I', 'SigPrTrnG', 'INSERIR', '')

lcChave = Emps+' - '+TpTrans+' - '+Tps
=fGravarLog('E', 'SigPrTrnG', 'EXCLUSAO', lcChave)

If Reccount() < lnReg

Else
	Go lnReg
Endif
